pool.text: Chandigarh was established following independence and partition.
Three possible sites for the new city were settled upon.
American town planner Albert Mayer was selected to design the master plan.
The government reached an agreement with affected villagers.
Architect Le Corbusier came to India to join the team.
State government departments and staff had been shifted from Shimla.
The capital was officially inaugurated in a ceremony presided over by President Rajendra Prasad.
Panjab University purchased land for a permanent campus.
The High Court became functional with modifications continuing later.
Sukhna Lake was created by damming a seasonal stream.
The Assembly building containing two legislative chambers was completed.
A ceremonial door hand painted by Corbusier was installed.
The former state was reorganised and divided into Haryana and Punjab.
Prime minister Indira Gandhi assigned the city to Punjab.
The Rock Garden was inaugurated after being built secretly by Nek Chand.
The Open Hand monument was completed.
Sukhna Wildlife Sanctuary was declared a wildlife sanctuary.
The Reserve Bank of India ranked Chandigarh as a major deposit and credit centre.
An international terminal was completed and international flight routes started.
A survey by LG Electronics ranked it as the happiest city in India.
